features.name: recency_log
features.description: Log-scaled months since last donation, compresses long tails for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, less skewed recency signal suitable for linear projection.

features.name: frequency_log
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths frequency distribution; aligns with linear separability.

features.name: monetary_log
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes a strongly right-skewed monetary feature for SVM margins.

features.name: tenure_log
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures donor tenure on a stable scale.

features.name: donations_per_active_month
features.description: Donation frequency normalized by active span (V4 - V1 + 1).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous engagement rate; strong linear severity indicator.

features.name: recency_to_tenure_ratio
features.description: Fraction of tenure represented by recency gap.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized inactivity proxy; near 1 indicates a dormant donor.

features.name: avg_volume_per_donation_dev
features.description: Deviation of per-donation volume from the standard 250 cc unit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags data inconsistencies; near zero confirms canonical donation behavior.

features.name: inactivity_gap
features.description: Months between expected donation cadence and current recency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Positive values indicate donor is overdue relative to their own cadence.

features.name: recency_severity_score
features.description: Clipped, normalized recency severity score in [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded recency feature improving SVM margin stability.

features.name: frequency_intensity_score
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded frequency-intensity score aligned with linear weights.

features.name: engagement_composite
features.description: Weighted linear composite: low recency, high frequency and tenure indicate active donor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-built linear projection that helps SVM margin separation.

features.name: donor_loyalty_judgment
features.description: Semantic loyalty score blending tenure depth, donation count, and recent activity: higher means the donor has a long, consistent, and recent donation history without relying on supervised signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic donor-loyalty signal capturing patterns not expressible as a single ratio.
